- **The last Marrow Agrisupply item may still be open:** Marrow escalated on 9 June about new stores rolling out too slowly. The open items were ticket PD-4821 (the Eastbank receiving-door import, where door labels don't match) and the missing morning shift at Pine Crossing. Nobody has posted since to say these are fixed.

I asked Hollis which date they meant and whether that escalation is closed. I only read #central-team, which Hollis is in.
